zh-CN.title: 失败图片可重试，消息操作更清晰
items: 九宫格中的单张图片上传失败后，可以直接点击失败标识重新上传
撤回移至消息首层操作，普通账号支持 2 分钟内撤回，VIP 支持 7 天内撤回
消息操作改为紧凑图标网格，操作增多时自动换行，不再横向挤出屏幕

en.title: Retry failed images and use clearer message actions
items: A failed photo inside an image grid can now be uploaded again directly from its retry badge
Recall is now a first-level message action, available for 2 minutes normally and 7 days for VIP members
Message actions now use a compact icon grid that wraps cleanly as more actions become available
